description: Edit up to 100 records of a collection by id (list_records gives the ids). Each edit is { id, data }: data names only the fields to change, a field left out keeps its value, and null empties a field; values take the shapes add_records takes. It changes the drafts, as an edit in Mapled does: the site shows the change once a human presses Publish. It writes the default language — a translated field takes one plain value here. Fields that hold sensitive values are refused: a human edits them in Mapled. The batch lands whole or not at all; the answer says which records changed (changed: false when the values were already the same).
name: update_records
